scripts.build: npm run build:bloodwork && npm run build:chat && npm run build:csm-portal
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:agent && npm run deploy:extract && npm run deploy:bloodwork && npm run deploy:chat && npm run deploy:csm-portal
scripts.test:parity: cd tools/pipeline && python3 tests/test_parity.py && cd ../.. && vitest run --project lab-core parity
scripts.test:all: npm run test:parity && vitest run && npm run test:hooks && npm run typecheck && npm run docs:check && npm run build && npm run check:bundle
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:bloodwork && vitest run --config tests/config/vitest.handoff.config.ts tests/e2e/visual.e2e.ts
scripts.test:audit: npm run build:bloodwork && vitest run --config tests/config/vitest.handoff.config.ts tests/e2e/audit.e2e.ts
scripts.test:audit:portal: npm run build:portal && vitest run --config tests/config/vitest.handoff.config.ts tests/e2e/audit-portal.e2e.ts
scripts.test:upload: VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY=e2e-upload npm run build:bloodwork && vitest run --config tests/config/vitest.handoff.config.ts tests/e2e/upload.e2e.ts
scripts.test:upload:portal: npm run build:portal && vitest run --config tests/config/vitest.handoff.config.ts tests/e2e/upload-portal.e2e.ts
scripts.test:identity: VITE_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY=e2e-identity npm run build:bloodwork && vitest run --config tests/config/vitest.handoff.config.ts tests/e2e/identity.e2e.ts
scripts.test:handoff: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:live
scripts.check:bundle: npm run check:bundle:bloodwork && npm run check:bundle:chat && npm run check:bundle:csm-portal
scripts.deploy:bloodwork: npm run build:bloodwork && npm run check:bundle:bloodwork && npm -w apps/bloodwork run deploy
scripts.deploy:portal: npm run build:portal && npm -w apps/portal run deploy
scripts.deploy:moje-krev: npm run deploy:portal-extract && npm run deploy:portal-api && npm run deploy:portal
scripts.deploy:chat: npm run build:chat && npm run check:bundle:chat && npm -w apps/chat run deploy
scripts.deploy:csm-portal: npm run build:csm-portal && npm run check:bundle:csm-portal && npm -w apps/csm-portal run deploy
